title.narrative: URRI - DRC Consortium

description.narrative: The objective of URRI is to contribute to enhanced climate resilience of women, men and youth in refugee and host communities and promote inclusive, cohesive, and environmentally sustainable development in refugee-affected areas in line with local priorities.
